title: Dermalogica Retinol Clearing Oil Review: Retinol + Salicylic Acid, How to Use It
description:
Dermalogica Retinol Clearing Oil: a night-time face oil with slow-release retinol and salicylic acid that helps optimize skin recovery, reduce the appearance of fine lines, wrinkles and hyperpigmentation, and target active breakouts.

We earn a commission if you buy through our link.

• Slow-release retinol works all night to help optimize skin recovery and reduce the appearance of fine lines, wrinkles and hyperpigmentation
• Salicylic acid targets active breakouts to help clear skin
• Lipid-based delivery system with skin-mimicking phytoactive lipids from argan, rosehip seed and golden jojoba oils
• At night, after cleansing, dispense 6-10 drops and smooth over face and neck, avoiding the eye area
